<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows ten distinct carbon signals. Peaks in the upfield region (≈10–30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The signals at 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, and 31.31 ppm fall within or just above this range, indicating six methyl (CH₃) groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
